description: This file defines the abstract class AbstractJob which implements the Job interface. It provides common functionality for job scheduling and execution, including state management, timing, and transaction handling.

classes.name: AbstractJob
classes.description: An abstract implementation of a Job that manages state, timing, and transaction cleanup.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the job.

methods.name: setCurrentState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the job.

methods.name: currentState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the job.

methods.name: getJobId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the job.

methods.name: getJobName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Transitions the job to the QUEUED state if it's in CREATED state.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Transitions the job back to the CREATED state if it's in QUEUED state.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the job's actual work; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the job, handles exceptions, ensures transaction cleanup, and records elapsed time.

methods.name: getRuntime
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time of the job's execution.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the job.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the job's priority, defaulting to JobPriority.NORMAL.
